name: find_free_block_run
description: Converts a byte count into 512-byte blocks rounded up, then scans forward through indexed entries up to a fixed upper limit, testing each with a helper call, looking for a run of free entries of that length. It returns failure when the scan passes the limit.

name: search_next_free_index
description: Counts a requested length down while advancing an index through a bounded range and testing each position with helper calls, restarting the count when a position fails. It returns the starting index of a completed run, or negative one if the range is exhausted.

name: wait_until_status_ready
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and re-reads a status value in a data register until it equals one, then returns. It performs no other work.

name: return_minus_one_result
description: Returns a sentinel value of negative one in both halves of the return pair without doing anything else. Three routines call it.

name: test_bitmap_bit
description: Reads the byte of a bitmap at the offset given by the index divided by eight, then tests the bit selected by the index's low three bits. It returns zero when the bit is clear and negative one when it is set.

name: clear_bitmap_bit
description: Clears the bit of a bitmap selected by an index, using the byte offset of the index divided by eight and the low three bits as the bit number. Only one caller uses it.

name: set_bitmap_bit
description: Sets the bit of a bitmap selected by an index, using the byte offset of the index divided by eight and the low three bits as the bit number. Only one caller uses it.

name: call_helper_and_pass_registers
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns the two incoming register values unchanged as a pair. It acts as a pass-through wrapper.

name: init_pointer_and_marker_word
description: Stores the address register plus a fixed offset into a shared pointer variable, writes all-ones into a marker word, and calls one helper. The decompiled code shows no other work.

name: call_single_helper
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is unknown. The listed facts show only one call to an unnamed routine, one caller, and an executed reference run; no other behaviour can be stated.

name: populate_grid_cell_records
description: Walks a run of cells, storing each cell's index, its address (advancing by 512 bytes per step), and its row and column obtained by dividing and taking the remainder by twelve. It calls helpers for each cell and makes an extra call when the remaining count is one or the column index is eleven.

name: return_zero_result
description: Returns zero in the return value with no other work. It is called once by the reference run.

name: poll_block_status_handshake
description: Waits on a flag bit, writes a set of control words into a register block, then polls a status word for a bounded number of iterations. It returns zero when a checked status condition holds and negative one otherwise.

name: mark_failed_cells_with_retries
description: Clears part of a status field, then walks rows of cells recording each cell's row, column and address. It retries a helper check up to a fixed number of times per cell and marks the cell byte with all-ones when every retry fails.

name: advance_cell_rows_with_retries
description: Steps to the next cell in a row and column walk, updating the stored row, column and address, and retries a helper check up to a fixed count per cell. It marks the cell on failure and returns once the remaining count reaches zero.

name: call_helper_return_result
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the stored return pair unchanged. It has no other logic.

name: fill_row_cells_with_breaks
description: Walks cells across a row, storing each cell's row, column and address, and calls helpers per cell. When the remaining count is one or the column index is eleven, it calls an extra helper to handle the row end.

name: call_helper_and_return_pair
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the stored value pair unchanged. It has no other logic.

name: read_fire_button_port_bit
description: Reads one bit of the CIA A port register that carries the fire buttons, returning zero when the bit is set and negative one when it is clear. It then writes all-ones to the CIA B port register.

name: set_state_from_helper_result
description: Sets a status field to one, calls a helper, and changes the status to two when the helper returns negative one. The only other call is to an empty stub that does nothing.

name: read_serial_32bit_value
description: Reads thirty-two bits one at a time from one bit of the CIA A port register, shifting each into an accumulator and resetting a port register after each bit. It returns the bitwise complement of the accumulated value.

name: select_timing_pair_by_input
description: Selects one of two pairs of timing bytes depending on whether the input is zero, and returns early for nonzero input unless a mode field equals two. When the input differs from the stored value, it stores the new value and marks two counter bytes with all-ones.

name: update_value_in_mode_two
description: When a mode field equals two, sets two fixed fields to sixteen and four. If the input differs from the stored value, it stores the input and marks two flags with all-ones; otherwise it does nothing.

name: load_cia_b_timer_value
description: Sets a control bit in the CIA B control register, writes a mask to the interrupt control register, then writes the low and high bytes of the input word into the CIA B timer A low and high registers.

name: wait_for_port_bit_clear
description: Repeatedly tests one bit of the CIA A port register and calls a helper while the bit stays set. It returns when the bit clears or after a fixed large number of iterations.

name: empty_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. One routine calls it.

name: clear_port_bit_and_flag
description: Clears the top bit of a port register, clears one bit chosen by a helper's result, calls a helper, and marks two status bytes with all-ones when a CIA A port bit is clear.

name: toggle_port_bits_by_index
description: Sets the top bit of a port register, then sets and clears single bits chosen by helper results, using a stored field as the first bit index.

name: write_masked_control_byte
description: Builds a control byte from a bit index stored in the structure, setting or clearing a fixed set of bits depending on a flag, and writes it to the target byte pointer. It calls a helper before and after the write.

name: strobe_control_byte_and_store
description: Builds a control byte from a bit index and a mode flag, writes it to a port three times with the low bit raised last, then compares a returned value with the stored value. It calls a helper and updates the stored value when they differ.

name: strobe_clear_bit_one
description: Clears bit one of a control byte, writes it to a port with the low bit raised last, then compares a returned value with the stored value. It calls a helper and updates the stored value when they differ.

name: wait_port_bit_while_flagging
description: Clears a flag, calls a helper, then loops while one port bit remains set, raising the flag and calling the helper on each pass. Afterwards it clears a second status byte.

name: clear_structure_status_byte
description: Sets one status byte in the structure to zero and returns. One caller uses it.

name: step_position_toward_target
description: Steps a current position byte toward a target byte one unit at a time, calling a helper for each step and setting a direction flag. It refuses targets above a fixed upper limit of seventy-nine by calling a helper and returning.

name: step_position_forward_count
description: Advances a current position byte upward by a count held in a data register, calling a helper on each step. It calls a second helper if the position exceeds the fixed upper limit of seventy-nine.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls one helper and returns. Two routines call it.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work. One routine calls it.

name: verify_signature_and_dispatch
description: Checks a returned value against two stored bytes and a fixed signature word, then compares two helper results. When they match it calls one of several helpers, chosen by the low bit of a flag and whether any upper flag bits are set.

name: dispatch_by_upper_flag_bits
description: Calls one of two helpers depending on whether any of the upper flag bits in a data register are set.

name: invoke_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper and returns. Two routines call it.

name: copy_sector_block_to_buffer
description: Copies a block from a source pointer to the destination buffer named in the structure, using 128 longword copies when the source is even-aligned or 512 single-byte copies otherwise. It then calls three helpers.

name: copy_longword_block_and_sync
description: Copies one hundred twenty-eight longwords from the source pointer to the destination pointer and then calls three helpers. The callers pass the buffers in address registers.

name: update_stored_value_if_changed
description: When the value at offset thirty-one differs from its stored copy, it splits the value into a shifted field and a low-bit flag, calls helpers, and stores the new value only if both helper results are nonnegative.

name: write_sync_pattern_with_retries
description: Fills a buffer with alternating-bit padding, writes two sync words, and fills a second region with padding. It then makes up to six attempts to start a DMA transfer, polling a status bit each time, and returns the result when the first sync word matches.

name: retry_sync_read_until_match
description: Repeatedly starts a DMA transfer and polls for completion with a bounded wait, checking a sync word after each attempt. It returns once the sync word matches or the retry count runs out.

name: noop_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. One routine calls it.

name: start_dma_read_with_mode
description: Calls helpers, then starts a DMA transfer from the buffer address stored in the structure. It picks one of two transfer control words depending on whether a count byte exceeds thirty-nine, then polls until the completion flag is set.

name: xor_fold_longword_block
description: Computes the exclusive-or of a run of longwords whose count is derived from the data register's length divided by four, then masks the high half of the result with an alternating-bit pattern.

name: call_three_helpers_pass_registers
description: Calls three helper routines in sequence and returns the incoming register values unchanged. Only one caller uses it.

name: store_inverted_mask_word
description: Derives a value from the even-position bits of the input by inverting and combining them with neighbouring bits, then stores that value OR'd with the input's even-position bits through a pointer. It clears the top bit of the derived value when the flag byte before the stored word is set.

name: update_top_bit_by_flag
description: Updates the top bit of a byte from the low bit of the preceding byte. It clears the top bit when that flag is set, and sets it when the flag is clear and bit six is clear; otherwise the byte is left unchanged.

name: store_byte_top_bit_clear
description: Writes the input byte to the pointed location with its top bit cleared.

name: decode_longword_pair_bits
description: Takes a pair of consecutive 32-bit words, masks each with an alternating-bit pattern, shifts the first one left by one, and combines the results into one 32-bit value.

name: run_blitter_four_passes
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then issues four blitter operations by writing source and destination pointers, control words and sizes. It waits for each operation to finish before starting the next, then calls three helpers.

name: reset_top_bit_by_flags
description: Clears the top bit of a byte, then sets it again when bit six is clear and the low bit of the preceding byte is clear.

name: run_blitter_offset_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs its first and last word masks, and sets source and destination addresses computed from an offset and two base pointers. It then starts a blitter operation and waits for it to finish.

name: combine_masked_longword_pairs
description: For each longword in a source block, combines its masked even-position bits, shifted left by one, with the masked bits of an entry a fixed distance ahead in the same block. The results are written to an output array.

name: combine_masked_byte_pairs
description: Byte version of the longword pairing routine: combines the masked even-position bits of each source byte, shifted left by one, with the masked bits of a byte a fixed distance ahead, and writes the results to an output array.

name: run_timed_read_status_check
description: Waits for a status bit, starts a DMA transfer using a stored address, and polls for completion for a fixed number of iterations. It then checks a result counter against a fixed threshold and returns zero on success or negative one on failure.

name: search_bitstream_for_sync_word
description: Scans a stream of words one bit at a time, shifting the window of bits, to find the position where a fixed sync word aligns. It returns the aligned word when found, or negative one once the scan counter runs out.

name: copy_block_backwards_from_end
description: Calls two helpers, then copies a block of longwords backwards from the end of a source region into a destination computed from a base pointer and a size field. It calls one more helper afterwards.

name: unpack_literal_and_backref_stream
description: Decodes a compressed byte stream by alternately copying literal bytes and copying earlier output at a back-reference distance. Control bits are shifted out of a byte, with carry tests selecting between the two copy modes.

name: reset_audio_channel_state
description: Calls a helper, sets a flag bit, clears a set of playback state words, zeroes the four audio channel volume registers, and then writes fifteen to a control register.

name: advance_tracker_tick_counter
description: Advances a per-tick counter, and when it wraps it runs a pattern step. The step accumulates a timing value against a threshold of one thousand twenty-four and advances a sequence index modulo one hundred twenty-eight, wrapping it against a length read from a table.

name: process_channel_effect_command
description: Processes one channel's effect command, selecting an action from the effect nibble through a switch that adjusts a period or volume. It writes the audio location registers of the channels when the channel flag is set.

name: load_note_sample_into_channel
description: Reads the next note from a pattern stream, and when the note is nonzero loads the associated instrument fields, period and volume into the channel structure. It calls helpers to set the effect parameters.

name: write_audio_channel_registers
description: Waits briefly, enables audio DMA bits, and copies the stored pointer and length values of the four audio channels into their hardware registers with short delays between steps. It then updates the tick counter.

name: run_effect_step_for_channel
description: Applies the effect in the channel's current command, choosing an action from its effect nibble through a switch. The action can include a period table lookup and adjustments to the stored period, and the result is stored in the channel's register field.

name: store_current_period_word
description: Copies the current period word from the channel structure into a second structure field at a fixed offset.

name: lookup_period_from_note_table
description: Scans a per-note table of up to thirty-six entries for the first entry not exceeding the current value, and stores the entry at an index taken from a nibble of the stored byte. A selector computed modulo three chooses between storing the current value directly and the table lookup.

name: scan_period_table_for_entry
description: Scans a per-note table of up to thirty-six entries for the first entry not exceeding the current value, then stores the entry at an index taken from a nibble of the stored byte.

name: store_current_word_field
description: Copies the current word field from the structure into a second structure field at a fixed offset.

name: scan_period_table_by_index
description: Scans a per-note table of up to thirty-six entries for the first entry not exceeding the current value, then stores the entry at an index taken from the input data register.

name: store_argument_word_field
description: Stores the word passed in a data register into a fixed field of the structure.

name: select_note_period_from_table
description: Finds the first table entry whose value does not exceed the masked note value, adjusts it by one step when a flag bit is set, and stores it. It also sets a direction byte depending on whether the entry is below the current value.

name: slide_period_toward_target
description: Moves a stored period toward a target by a per-step rate, clamping at the target. When a nibble of the effect byte is set it looks up the matching table entry, and it returns the effect value.

name: advance_period_slide_step
description: Performs one step of a period slide toward the target, clamping at the target and storing the resulting value. It uses the table lookup when the effect nibble is nonzero.

name: subtract_step_from_period
description: Subtracts the input step from the current period, clamps it at a target value, and looks up the matching table entry when the effect nibble is nonzero. It returns the effect selector.

name: compute_vibrato_offset_period
description: Advances a phase counter and computes a waveform value, either from a table lookup or a generated ramp, scales it by a depth nibble, and adds the result to the base period. The waveform choice comes from a control field.

name: slide_volume_up_or_down
description: Adjusts a channel volume by a slide amount: the high nibble adds to it, capped at sixty-four, and otherwise the low nibble subtracts from it, floored at zero. The result is stored in the output field.

name: slide_volume_and_store_period
description: Stores the current period word into a structure field, then adjusts a volume byte by the high nibble of the parameter, capped at sixty-four, or by subtracting the low nibble with a floor at zero. The result goes to a second field.

name: process_channel_effect_nibble
description: Handles the effect nibble of a channel command through a switch, where one case scales an offset by one hundred twenty-eight, one sets a position byte from the parameter minus one, and one converts the two parameter nibbles into a decimal value. It calls six helpers.

name: store_low_nibble_parameter
description: Stores the low nibble of the parameter byte into a fixed channel field.

name: advance_pointer_and_invert_byte
description: When the high nibble of the parameter is nonzero, adds a table value to a counter. When the counter's top bit is set, it resets the counter, advances a pointer within a bounded buffer that wraps to its start, and negates the byte there.

name: copy_four_word_blocks
description: Copies four blocks of words, where each block's source, destination and length are read from consecutive entries of a descriptor table.

name: check_stack_bounds_trap
description: Checks the stack pointer against two stored limits and raises a trap if it lies outside them. The rest of the decoded code is bad instruction data, so no other behaviour is described.

name: stub_constant_word_sequence
description: Writes a fixed list of constant words to one location. The sequence reads as table data decoded as instructions rather than a meaningful routine, and only the reference run enters it.

name: stub_constant_word_return_byte
description: Writes a fixed list of constant words to one location and returns the incoming byte unchanged. The sequence reads as table data decoded as instructions rather than a meaningful routine.

name: stub_short_constant_sequence
description: Writes a short fixed list of constant words to one location. The sequence reads as table data decoded as instructions rather than a meaningful routine.

name: write_display_window_stop_words
description: Writes a fixed list of constant words, including values for the display window stop register. The sequence reads as copper-list-style data decoded as code rather than as a routine.

name: stub_constant_word_tail
description: Writes a fixed tail of constant words to one location. The sequence reads as table data decoded as instructions rather than a meaningful routine.

name: write_display_window_stop_tail
description: Writes a fixed tail of constant words that includes a display window stop register value. The sequence reads as copper-list-style data decoded as code rather than as a routine.

name: stub_constant_word_tail_short
description: Writes a short fixed tail of constant words to one location. The sequence reads as table data decoded as instructions rather than a meaningful routine.

name: write_display_window_stop_short
description: Writes a short fixed list of constant words that includes a display window stop register value. The sequence reads as copper-list-style data decoded as code rather than as a routine.

name: write_constant_single_word
description: Writes one fixed constant word to a single location and returns. It reads as a fragment of table data decoded as code.

name: write_display_window_stop_last
description: Writes a fixed trailing list of constant words that includes a display window stop register value. The sequence reads as copper-list-style data decoded as code rather than as a routine.

name: empty_return_stub_at_offset
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. The code is a single return instruction decoded from a data region.

name: write_display_window_stop_pair
description: Writes a fixed pair of constant words that includes a display window stop register value. The sequence reads as copper-list-style data decoded as code rather than as a routine.

name: advance_position_with_wrap
description: Adds three to a position word in the structure. When the position passes four hundred eighty-seven, it increments a shared counter and resets the position to a fixed high flag value.

name: clear_fixed_address_word
description: Writes zero to one fixed low-memory word and returns. It is a small reset of a single variable.

name: increment_counter_on_flag_condition
description: When the overflow and negative condition flags match, increments a shared counter and sets a fixed high flag value.

name: set_high_flag_word
description: Sets one shared word to a fixed high flag value and returns.

name: initialise_two_counters
description: Sets one counter to five and a second shared variable to four hundred, then returns. The second variable is also read by other routines.

name: step_state_and_return_offset
description: Decrements a countdown, and when it reaches zero resets it to four and toggles a shared state value between zero and forty. It returns the state scaled by eight plus the input word.

name: return_state_scaled_plus_input
description: Returns the shared state value scaled by eight plus the input word.

name: return_state_scaled_plus_input
description: Returns the shared state value scaled by eight plus the input word.

name: return_state_scaled_plus_input
description: Returns the shared state value scaled by eight plus the input word.

name: decrement_and_advance_state
description: Decrements a shared countdown and, when it reaches zero, increments a shared state counter and sets a fixed high flag value. It returns the state scaled by eight plus the input word.

name: write_record_bytes_and_flags
description: Stores the two bytes of an input word into a record, clears one indexed byte, and sets a bit in a bitmap. If a flag byte is set it clears two fields of a second record, then returns a combined value.

name: reset_fields_if_flag_set
description: When the shared flag byte is nonzero, clears a longword field and sets a word field to two in the structure, then returns.

name: arm_callback_when_flagged
description: When the shared flag byte is nonzero, sets a state word to one, stores a callback pointer in the structure, and sets a countdown to twenty.

name: advance_position_after_countdown
description: Decrements a countdown and, once it goes negative, advances a position word by three. When the position passes three hundred nineteen, it increments a shared counter and sets a fixed high flag value.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without any work.
